name: telem-brand-palette
description: Warm home palette for the תלם brand system. Six colors, each with one job — do not introduce tints/shades outside this list in branding assets.

cream.role: canvas / paper — backgrounds, negative space, light-on-dark fills

mint.role: primary brand color — the house mark body, main accents

pine.role: depth — shading, hover states, secondary accents, tagline text

coral.role: warmth — doors, hearts, primary actions in illustrations, error tone (soft, never harsh red)

sun.role: joy — windows, chimney toppers, highlights, success sparkle

navy.role: ink — wordmark text, outlines, dark backgrounds (app icon, favicon plate)

usage.accentPairing: mint + pine for structure, coral + sun for warmth and life
